now_the_spec_says: CADENCE_S = 60.0 is the standing cadence and the bound a beat is judged against. 2f0a6ea8c966's falsifier clause 'under 1.0s' names a superseded cadence, is retired, and re-reads against 60.0s. The measured 23.7s beat is GREEN; the ticket closes to PROVED.
context: Fired at the close of the voyage Akien's own red opened on 2026-09-07: 'i can't imagine why we should need to parse all class space every 60 seconds. that's not efficient.' Four fixes took the beat from 104.8s to 23.7s steady state (42c9e15 the chart-chain packet index, 11d2ec0 once()+_pulse for the pulse context nothing ever populated, e53a973 settled() for corpus scans on a clock, af50ab8 the 'context or {}' that had every shim swapping out the beat's own dict). CC then found that this work was ALREADY CAST — 2f0a6ea8c966 sat at BUILDME:waiting with the fix design written in its `how` — and that its falsifier number predated Akien's own cadence change. CC put the one spec question to him rather than deciding it: 23.7s is red against 1.0s and green against 60.0s, and which is the verdict is his. WHY THIS IS A RULING AND NOT A NOTE: the ticket's `owner` field says the cadence bound is explicitly not CC's to move ('Widening either to make the numbers below look better is the plaster the 2026-08-14 rule forbids'), so a falsifier re-read against a wider bound is exactly the act that requires his signature. Law 9 caps his word at measurement, and nothing here overrides one: the 23.7s is measured (scratchpad/beat_steady.py, three beats in one process) and this ruling settles only which bound it is compared TO. WHAT DIES, recorded here because the gate takes only resolvable paths in what_dies and this is a CLAUSE inside a file, not a file: the '1.0s' bound in 2f0a6ea8c966's falsifier.proves_red. Its other clause — 'a file touched between two beats is seen by the second' — is untouched and still binds. ALSO DYING: the corrosion reading CC nearly filed, that CADENCE_S moved 1.0 -> 60.0 with no ruling behind it. There WAS a ruling (Akien, 2026-08-22, landed in cairn 6ae83e7, which he authored); what was missing was a packet in CairnCommons/decisions/, and its absence is what made the move look like drift. This packet is that record, arriving late.
